title: MySQL: Add dissector for binlog event HEARTBEAT_LOG_EVENT_V2
description:
There is no dissector for MySQL binlog events in the current Wireshark, I'm going to add dissectors for those events. 

### pcap

[mysql80-repl.pcapng](/uploads/d91ee80649c65ff845fef38ae8b4fff0/mysql80-repl.pcapng)

### The old dissection result

![image](/uploads/cbdee0c6e800d0d92c8b895f8e4a22ab/image.png)

### With this patch

![image](/uploads/19d1cad381ed72ae6fa234f995c7ac09/image.png)
